job_spec.purpose: S81 PQ core (dsfd_sp_pq cluster) child: T_BC broadcast relay ot_pqc_t_bc (1,630 b, only valid / config bits reset) as an M5 recipe-2 reference tile. The closed view (el1011-pqc-bc-pka-5e6ab1fda: 40 x 100, pins M4 + M6, PG M7) cannot be a cluster child (PG must be <= M6) and no M5 route of it was ever submitted (reroute_m5 10-12 18:24 only proposed 40 x 188.64). Outline 43.2 x 190.08: the W / E faces carry 1,630 pins each on M4 alone (2 tracks per pin), d[i] and q[i] at the same height (pin_balance over one range) so the cluster's five-stage relay chain is straight M4. Same RTL as the closed tile.
